title: Death Note: The Japanese Films
blurb: Live-action adaptations of the manga, plus a spin-off and a later sequel.

deathnote16.t: Death Note: Light Up the New World

note: The first two are one story split in half. L: Change the World is a side story branching from the second film's ending, and Light Up the New World jumps ten years ahead. The 2017 American film is unrelated.
